Voxel Cone Tracing | OGRE - Open Source 3D Graphics Engine
Learn how Voxel Cone Tracing (VCT) works and how it can improve the quality and performance of global illumination in OGRE, an open source 3D graphics engine. See examples of VCT with different lighting, specular, HDR and anisotropic settings.
